questions.prompt: `./prog a b c` is run. What are `argc` and `argv[2]`?
questions.explain: `argv[0]` is the program name, so there are 4 entries: `./prog`, `a`, `b`, `c`. `argv[2]` is `"b"`.
option_notes: argc counts the program name too.

questions.prompt: Which `main` signature also receives the environment variables?
options: int main(int argc, char *argv[], int envc)
questions.explain: Unix (as a common extension) passes a third parameter, a NULL-terminated array of `"NAME=value"` strings. `getenv("NAME")` is the portable way to read one variable.
